name: Almaria Residences Phase E
pinSource: Developer's own Almaria Residences page (karmadevelopers.com/projects/almaria-residences) embeds a Google Maps place marker q=35.03006911278542,34.03141212327931 (a marker, not a camera position). That page covers the whole Almaria scheme (phases A-D); there is no separate Phase E page. Checked against OSM: the marker is ~0.9 km from Pernera Beach (Phase E presentation says 900 m) and ~1.2 km from Paralimni Marina (presentation says 1 km). The 'ALMARIA all phases' aerial (presentation p.10) shows Phase E directly next to Phase A on the west side, so the true Phase E plot is within roughly 100-200 m of this marker. Medium confidence for the exact plot; high confidence for the location.

facts: Almaria Residences Phase E is an off-plan scheme of 9 detached two-storey villas in Pernera, Protaras area, Famagusta district; it is the latest phase of the larger Almaria Residences development.
All villas have three bedrooms; per the price list they have 3-4 bathrooms and internal areas of about 139-160 m², plus 12.25-27.55 m² of covered verandas.
Plots range from 267 m² to 402 m²; the largest villa, H01 (Type C), has 159.6 m² internal area, 27.55 m² of covered verandas and a 402 m² plot.
Every villa has its own skimmer pool of 3 x 7 m, 1.40 m deep, finished with glass mosaic.
The developer states Pernera Beach is about 900 m away, Kalamies Beach 850 m, Paralimni Marina 1 km, supermarkets and restaurants about 400 m, Protaras centre 2.5 km and Larnaca airport 45 km.

Specification includes a 3 kWp photovoltaic system, provision for a 32 A EV charger, CAT6 cabling to all rooms, air-conditioning provision in all bedrooms and the living area, and solar water heating.

External walls are 25 cm thermal clay brick with an external thermal insulation system; windows are MU3000/MU2075 thermal aluminium with double glazing; balconies have 16 mm laminated glass balustrades.
Kitchens get 12 mm ceramic-slab worktops and backsplash; bathrooms have wall-hung WCs and glass shower cubicles.
The villas carry an A energy performance certificate.

conflicts: Presentation key-facts page (p.11) says 'Build Area 173 m² - 202.7 m²'. That does not match the Phase E plans or price list (internal 138.98-159.6 m²); 173 and 202.7 m² are exactly the Phase D villa sizes on the developer website, so this slide looks carried over from Phase D. Price list figures used.
Presentation p.8 says the nearest beach is 900 m (Pernera), while the location slide gives Kalamies Beach as 850 m. Small internal inconsistency.

Price list says covered parking for all 9 villas; plans for H01-H04 show a covered-parking area (20.6-21.9 m²) but the Type A1/A2 plans (H05-H09) list no covered-parking figure (the A1 render does show a cantilevered canopy at the entrance).
Plans for H05-H09 all print 'Plot Area = 270 m²', while the price list gives individual plot sizes from 267 m²; price list wins.
The spec sheet mentions a TV point at the 'roof garden', but no plan or price-list row mentions an accessible roof garden for Phase E.

Almaria Phase D (folder /LIFESTYLE/ALMARIA D, 12 villas, 3-4 bed) is NOT on the price list, but the developer's website still shows it as 'Phase D - Available - OFF PLAN' with villa D06 marked AVAILABLE (D01, D03-D05, D09, D11, D12 reserved; D02, D07, D08, D10 sold) and the construction timeline calls Phase D 'Under Construction'. So Phase D is not completed and possibly not fully sold out; it is simply absent from the current price list.
There are no Phase E interior images in the share (no '2. interior pictures' folder); the presentation has interior renders on pp. 25-27 only inside the PDF.
openQuestions: Expected construction start and completion (delivery quarter) for Phase E.
